text:
What is the gain? The company of the virtuous. What is misery? The company of the unwise.
What is the loss? Deviating from the right path. What is proficiency? Love for the essence of Dharma.
Who is the hero? One who has conquered his senses. Who is the most beloved? One who is devoted to her vows. What is wealth? Knowledge.
What is happiness? Not having to wander far from home. What is sovereignty? The fruit of command.
